in_marathi.name: Ayukta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayukta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayukta is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘a’ (not) and ‘yukta’ (joined, fit). It refers to someone who is not bound by societal norms and is self-governed. In Hindu mythology, Ayukta is an epithet for various gods and goddesses, representing supreme power and authority.
